capabilities: Delay autosave until a configurable idle period after the last edit
Disable automatic saving and save only via the Save File command
Defer writes to the workspace.json layout file
Show save state as a color-coded status bar indicator
Warn on quitting with unsaved changes and list affected notes
extras: README warns that changes held in memory can be lost if Obsidian or the system crashes before a save, that save-reactive features (e.g. the Outline pane) update late, and that force-killing the mobile app right after editing can lose the last edit. Also documents compatibility behavior with disk-rewriting plugins like Templater, Linter, Frontmatter Modified Date, and Custom Attachment Location.
problem: Obsidian saves every ~2 seconds while typing, which can cause sync conflicts with cloud storage, performance issues on large files, and battery drain.

relations.evidence: This plugin can be installed and auto-updated with BRAT (Beta Reviewers Auto-update Tester)
Plugins that rewrite a note directly on disk (Frontmatter Modified Date, Linter, Templater, sync clients, ...)

summary: Save-control plugin that delays Obsidian's automatic saves or disables them, letting users save manually to reduce file writes.
